basic_details.job_title: TMC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Technician, Scientific Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Tata Memorial Centre (TMC) has released the TMC Recruitment 2026 notification for 4 vacancies for Scientific Assistant and Technician posts in the Radiodiagnosis department at Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh. The recruitment includes Ad-hoc Scientific Assistant ‘B’, Ad-hoc Technician ‘C’, Scientific Assistant on Contract Basis, and Technician on Contract Basis. Eligible candidates with the required educational qualifications and relevant CT/MRI experience can apply online from the official website. The last date to submit the online application is 28 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM (Indian Standard Time).

how_to_apply: Visit the official online application link provided for the respective advertisement before the closing date.
Fill out the online application form with accurate details.
Ensure a valid email ID is provided, as all correspondence with the applicant will be done through email only.
Submit the application online on or before 28.10.2026 upto 05.00 PM (Indian Standard Time). Candidates must send in their candidature through “Online Application” only.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Internal candidates need to submit NOC from their current HOD/OIC/Principal Investigator. Tata Memorial Centre / Agency does not take any responsibility for non-receipt of application through Online. All the outstation candidates are required to make a note that accommodation will not be provided. Tata Memorial Centre / Agency reserves the right not to call any candidates to appear for Interview without assigning any reason thereof.

content_sections.heading: About TMC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Tata Memorial Centre conducts recruitments for deployment at Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre (MPMMCC) / Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre located in Sunder Bagiya, BHU Campus, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh -221005 (Phone No. 0542-6917700). The recruitments cover direct ad-hoc appointments as well as outsourced positions through M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. for radiodiagnosis departments.

rows.details: Tata Memorial Centre (TMC) / Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre (MPMMCC) / Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre, Varanasi
Ad-hoc Scientific Assistant ‘B’ (Radiodiagnosis), Ad-hoc Technician ‘C’ (Radiodiagnosis), Scientific Assistant (Radiodiagnosis) On Contract Basis, Technician (Radiodiagnosis) On Contract Basis
Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 30,000/- or Rs. 23,870/- per month depending on the post

rows.essential_education_and_experience: B.Sc. (Radiological Imaging Technology) from a recognized University with 50% marks OR B.Sc. in any subject / B. Pharmacy with 50% marks and minimum two years' Diploma in Medical Imaging Technology from State Board of Technical Education OR Any equivalent recognized Board / University. Essential Experience: Minimum 01 year Internship / experience from a large hospital with experience in CT and MRI.

12th Std. in Science and Diploma of one year / 6 months in Medical Imaging Technology from government recognized institute. Essential Experience: 03 years' experience from a large a large hospital with experience in CT and MRI.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment for direct ad-hoc posts will be initially for a period of Six months or till the occupancy of regular post whichever is earlier. Contractual appointments via M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. will be initially for a period of six months which may be extended further depending upon the performance of the candidate and the requirement of the institute.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be initially screened and called for Interview on the basis of information provided by them in the online application form. Candidates who would be called for Interview are required to carry original documents in support of the details furnished in the online application form regarding date of birth, qualifications, experience, etc., failing which such applicants will not be allowed to appear for Interview.

Tata Memorial Centre / Agency reserves the right not to call any candidates to appear for Interview without assigning any reason thereof.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online application is 28.10.2026 upto 05.00 PM (Indian Standard Time).

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for TMC Ad-hoc Scientific Assistant 'B' posts?
faq.answer: The age limit as on Last date of Application is 30 years.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly remuneration for the Scientific Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 30,000/-.

faq.question: Q4. How many total vacancies are announced across these notifications?
faq.answer: A total of 4 posts are available across the direct ad-hoc and contractual notifications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for Ad-hoc Technician 'C' (Radiodiagnosis)?
faq.answer: 12th Std. in Science and Diploma of one year / 6 months in Medical Imaging Technology from government recognized institute, along with 03 years' experience from a large a large hospital with experience in CT and MRI.

faq.question: Q6. Are outstation candidates provided with accommodation?
faq.answer: All the outstation candidates are required to make a note that accommodation will not be provided.

faq.question: Q7. Through which agency are the contractual positions deployed?
faq.answer: M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. are an Outsourcing Agency for the Supply of Manpower Services to HBCH and MPMMCC, Varanasi on contract basis.
